title: Law to create one online application for senior and disabled rent exemptions
summary: Int. No. 307 would require the Department of Finance and the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to jointly build a single online and paper application and recertification system for the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption and Disability Rent Increase Exemption programs. It would also require a public website to check eligibility and apply or recertify for these benefits. The bill set a deadline of December 31, 2025 for these systems to be in place.
